title: Foo Bar Taxi Natural Language Chat Interface
description: Design an analytics schema from pre-seeded raw NYC taxi data and build a natural language chat endpoint that translates user questions into ClickHouse SQL queries and returns answers.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must design an analytics schema over pre-seeded NYC taxi data and build a chat endpoint that accepts natural language questions like 'How many trips were there?' and translates them into ClickHouse SQL to return accurate answers.

tasks.description: Design a proper analytics table in ClickHouse from the raw staging data with appropriate column types, a taxi_type discriminator, and ORDER BY suitable for analytical queries.
Build an HTTP chat endpoint that accepts natural language questions about taxi data and translates them into ClickHouse SQL queries to return accurate answers.
Ensure the chat endpoint returns answers within tolerance for the test questions in /data/taxi/test_questions.json.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse pre-seeded with raw.yellow_trips_2024_01 and raw.green_trips_2024_01 staging tables. Test questions with expected answers in /data/taxi/test_questions.json.
